webSearch.description: Yana sarrafa yadda bincike kai tsaye ke tafiya idan yanayin Bincike yana aiki. Sauye-sauyen suna aiki nan da nan.
webSearch.providerAutoDescription: Yana amfani da tsohon tsarin aiwatarwa — a yanzu haɗin bincike labarai da ke ƙasa.
webSearch.providerNewsDescription: Yana tambaya daga kowanne tushe a lokaci guda kuma yana haɗa sakamako, don haka rashin nasarar ɗaya ba zai katse bincike ba. Mafi daidaito ga saurin aiki, bambance-bambancen tushe da haɗin makala masu aiki.
webSearch.providerGoogleNewsDescription: A asirce kuma da sauri — tambayar bincike kaɗai ke isa Google (ba asusu ko cookies) kuma sakamako na zuwa cikin kusan dakika guda. Lura: mafi yawa yana duba babban take da gajarce-gajarce, ba cikakkun makaloli ba, don haka amsoshi na iya zama saman-saman.

webSearch.providerBingDescription: Yana karanta cikakkun shafuka don fassarar zurfi kuma yana rufe duka intanet, ba labarai kaɗai ba. Amma bincike yakan ɗauki dakika 30–90 kuma ingancin sakamako na iya bambanta.
webSearch.sourcesDescription: Adadin tushe daban-daban da bincike ke rike dasu a matsayin ambato. Tambayoyin binciken kimiyya na iya faɗaɗa wannan ta atomatik.
webSearch.freshnessDescription: Yaushe sakamakon yakamata ya kasance. Ta atomatik yana bawa kowanne tambaya damar yanke (labaran gaggawa na fi son na rana daya da ta wuce).
webSearch.providerCombined: Bincike mai zurfi da kanun labarai na farko (Bing + Google News)
webSearch.providerCombinedDescription: Yana gudanar da Bing grounding da Google News tare: kanun labarai suna bayyana cikin daƙiƙu yayin da bincike mai zurfi na Bing ke ci gaba. Kuna iya zaɓar amsa daga kanun labarai cikin gaggawa maimakon jiran binciken mai jinkiri. Idan Bing ya gama, ana haɗa sakamakon biyu.
webSearch.providerBingResponsesDescription: Irin wannan rufin yanar gizo na Bing kamar Bing grounding, ana gudanar da shi a matsayin kira guda daya na samfurin kai tsaye maimakon Foundry agent — yawanci yafi sauri. Sabon zaɓi da ake duba dacewarsa da Bing grounding.

gpt_5_2.name: GPT-5.2

gpt_5_2_chat.name: GPT-5.2 Chat

Dace da hirarraki na yau da kullum, shawarwari, da ayyukan da ke bukatar fahimtar motsin rai.
